notes.title: Syder Reloaded Update 1
notes.content:
We just released an update for Syder Reloaded to address some important features that were missing or incomplete in our initial release.

Added support for V-Sync. Check out the options menu.

Added support for Steam Cloud saves

Fixed a soft-lock bug in the logic of the fourth level of the campaign (Unfinished Business).

Fixed a minor issue that could cause a soft lock at the end of the Lighthouse Survival level.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

Have fun, Starfighters!

notes.title: Today is Release Day: Syder Reloaded is now available!
notes.content:
Hello Syder pilots! Almost exactly 13 years after the release of Syder Arcade, the remastered version of Studio Evil's first title is now available on Steam! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38870175/b451ab0e439dae214c17a3cf9d1a5b82503f3b71.png

This is not just a new edition, it's a brand new game! Compared to the original title, this is what you can find in Syder Reloaded:

 New and improved graphics
 The classic ships have been rebalanced
 We added 4 new playable ships
 Improved online leaderboards
 Improved storytelling, better dialogues and brand new opening and and ending cinematics
 New alternative anime character portraits
 New enemies
 A new boss fight!
 Improved levels, some of hem have been rebuilt from the ground-up!
 Redesigned powerup and special weapon systems
 New score system with combos, grazing and bullet cancelling!

We want to thank our community for the unstoppable support (and the incredible patience) we have seen during these years. For you who already own Syder Arcade, you can benefit from the dedicated Syder Bundle, which will allow you to purchase Syder Reloaded with a special 60% discount for the first month after release.

You can also find Syder Reloaded available on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5. We have partnered with Strictly Limited to offer a retail limited version for console, which we are very thankful for.

Also, don't forget to join our Discord server!

Enjoy your space adventure and good luck!

notes.title: Syder Reloaded: The Return of the Furiously Overcharged Hybrid Shmup
notes.content:
From Spring 2021, Syder Reloaded revives the Syder series in this love-letter to Amiga shmups with upgraded graphics and refined gameplay. 

Shooter games have a place in the heart of many gamers, and many remember the glory days of hardcore arcade action. We built our first game, Syder Arcade, as an evening side-project and soon became obsessed with competing with each other for high scores and bragging rights. Eight years since the success of Arcade, we're bringing Syder Reloaded to Steam. 

Existing Syder Arcade players will still be able to play the original iteration, and will receive a very special offer in picking up the new game. More details revealed soon! 

What is Syder Reloaded? 
An overcharged and furious side-scrolling, multi-directional shoot 'em up.

Syder Reloaded is the love letter to 90s Amiga shmups you've always wanted, remastering and expanding on Syder Arcade, the classic shoot-em-up, bullet-hell hybrid you know and love. A slew of challenging levels, a fleet of distinct ships and a motherload of alien invaders. Get back to your old-school roots and curse at your monitor in this skills-first shooter.

No items to upgrade, nothing to grind through, no coins needed for continues; your progress is solely measured by your individual skill. If you're looking for a game that delivers a straight shot of nostalgia and 90s challenge, you'll find nothing better. Pick up your controller or reach for your keyboard, will you master Syder Reloaded?
[previewyoutube=1YZrVZ1NC4Q;full][/previewyoutube]
👉 WISHLIST SYDER RELOADED ON STEAM 👈

Key Features:

 6 Legendary Levels: A challenging Campaign Mode packed with guns, glory, and buckets of adversity for you to overcome!

 Choose Your Ship: Even more superb starships ready to be commanded, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. Choose wisely!

 How Far Can You Go?: 3 different Survival and Challenge Mode levels, perfect for pilots wishing to showcase their skills. 

 Online Leaderboards: Take control of the all-new scoring system and make your mark on the Global Leaderboards, or go personal and fight for bragging rights at the top of your friends list. 

 Play with What You’ve Got: Pick up a controller or reach for your keyboard, how you play is up to you.

 Travel Back in Time: Apply a suite of retro graphic filters to change the way you see the game and bring that wonderful hit of nostalgia from the 90s!

 No Grind, Just Glory: Earn your place among the elite, winning badges and high scores based on skill and ability, not hours invested.

 Big Bosses Await: Go head-to-head against monstrously-sized ships. Will you overcome these alien invaders?

 A Challenge with Choices: Pick from up to 4 levels of difficulty, so you can set your own challenge. Rise to the maximum as you master your ship!
